translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A slesal jun vin̈ icham vinac

content.text: Mamin Jehová, a d'ayach tzin col in b'a, mocab' in can d'a q'uixvelal uuj.
Colin, colinel d'a yol sc'ab' eb' ajc'ool yajoch d'ayin, yujto tojol ach. Ab' val tas svala', tzin a colani.
Ochan̈ ven̈uloc icha junoc n̈aq'ueen b'aj syal in colan in b'a. Ala' to tzin colchaji yujto icha in cuartel aji, icha in n̈aq'ueen aji.
Ach in Diosal, colinel d'a eb' chuc, d'a eb' milumcham anima yed' d'a eb' ixtum anima.
Mamin Jehová Vajalil, toxonton yip ach in c'ool yictax d'a in quelemal.
Yictax ix in alji d'a ix in nun, a d'ayach svic' vip. A ach ix in ac' aljoc. Ol ach in b'itejn̈ej.
Tzijtum mach sat sc'ol yilan tas tzin ic'ani, palta ach in Diosal, an̈ej d'ayach tzin col in b'a.
Masanil tiempo, sval vach' lolonel d'ayach yuj snivanil elc'ochi.
Man̈ in a patiquejeli, yujto icham vinaquinxo. Man̈ in actejcani yujto man̈xalaj vip.
A eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin sgana in smilanchamoc, smol yetb'eyum eb', slajtian sb'a eb' d'a in patic.
Syalan eb': Pechec, yamec. Man̈xo ayococh Dios yed'oc, man̈xalaj mach ol colanel ticnaic, xchi eb'.
Ach in Diosal, man̈ najatoc tzach el d'a in tz'ey. Cotan̈ d'a elan̈chamel, ochan̈ ved'oc.
A eb' ayoch ajc'olal d'ayin, chamocab' eb' yuj q'uixvelal. A eb' tz'alan tas chuc d'a in patic yic tzin yixtan eb' yalani, malajocab' tz'ajcan yelc'och eb'.
Palta, a inxo tic ach in Diosal, ayachn̈ej och yipoc in c'ol d'a junjun rato. Ol ach in b'itej yed' in tzalajc'olal.
Masanil tiempo ol valel yab'ixal a tojolal yed' a colval, vach'chom max nachaj vuuj smasanil.
Mamin Jehová Cajalil, a juntzan̈ tastac te satub'tac ix a c'ulej, a' ol in b'itej. Ol valel ab'ixal to a achn̈ej tojol ach.
Ach in Diosal, yictax in quelemal, ix in a c'ayb'ani. An̈ejtona' valanel juntzan̈ tastac nivac b'ob'ilcan uuj ticnaic.
Ach in Diosal, vach'chom icham inxo, sacxo xil in jolom, palta man̈ in actejcani yic ol yal valanel yab'ixal a poder d'a eb' toto ol aljoc.
Ach in Diosal, yelxo val te nivan a tojolal icha snajatil satchaan̈. Nivan tastac ix a c'ulej. Malaj junoc mach icha ach tic.
Vach'chom tzijtum tas ix in ic'ani yed' yaelal ix ac' d'ayin, palta ol in ac'xi pitzvoc. Ol in ic'xiq'ueta d'a sjulal lum luum.
Te nivan ol aj velc'och uuj, ol ac'anpax snivanil in c'ool.
A inxo tic, ol ach in b'itej yujto tzaq'uelc'och tas tzala'. Ol vac'an yuj diosal d'ayach yed' te' arpa yed' te' chin̈b'il. Ach in Diosal, co Diosal ach a on̈ aj israel on̈ tic.
Ol ach in b'itej d'a tzalajc'olal, yujto ix in a colo'.
Ol valel a tojolal d'a masanil q'uinal. A eb' ix nib'an to ay tas ix in ic'ani, ix telvi eb', ix te q'uixvicanel eb'.
